verdicts.reason: A: about 150px of dead space above a small left-aligned headline, a large gap between headline and subhead, and an oversized centred logo that dominates the middle and outranks the message; left-aligned text sits next to centred logo and CTA, so the alignment is mixed and nothing reads as one group. B has the same faults (oversized logo, small left-aligned headline far from its subhead, centred CTA under left-aligned copy) but keeps the original's logo → headline → CTA reading order and fills the top of the canvas, so it is slightly less broken.
